name: teable
description: Works with your Teable projects: queries and analyzes records, creates, updates and deletes them, manages tables and fields, and builds Teable apps locally with the teable CLI.

displayDescription.en: Connects to your Teable account to query and analyze data, create, update and delete records, manage tables and fields, and build and publish Teable apps from your machine.
displayDescription.zh: 连接 Teable 多维表格，查询分析数据，增删改记录，管理表和字段，并在本地搭建发布应用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 列出我的 Teable 项目和每个项目里的表
defaultInitPrompt.en: List my Teable projects and the tables in each one

quickPrompts.zh: 列出我的 Teable 项目和每个项目里的表

quickPrompts.zh: 按负责人汇总项目表里未完成的任务

quickPrompts.zh: 在客户表里新增一条线索记录
